# listmonk_default_template (Resource)

Sets the default campaign template of the listmonk instance. There can be only one default, so declare this resource at most once. Destroying it leaves the current default in place: listmonk always has a default template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "listmonk_template" "branded" {
  name = "Branded"
  type = "campaign"
  body = file("${path.module}/templates/branded.html")
}

# New campaigns use this template unless they pick another one.
resource "listmonk_default_template" "this" {
  template_id = listmonk_template.branded.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `template_id` (Number) ID of the campaign template to make the default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `default`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is ignored; the current default is read from listmonk.
terraform import listmonk_default_template.this default
```
